summary: The preview panel migration leaves a stale useEffect and swallows render errors. The new duplicate API hardcodes a service-role key, skips auth, trusts client gmId, leaks stack traces, and omits prerender=false. A migration adds a table without RLS. Dashboard layout change is out of scope. No tests for the new route.

acceptanceCriteria.note: CI status cannot be verified from the diff alone.
Missing prerender=false on duplicate route; migration lacks RLS.
dashboard.astro layout tweak unrelated to stated change.
E2E is not a merge gate yet.

findings.title: Preview effect never re-runs when content changes
findings.description: useEffect calls renderHandoutHtml with markdownContent and backgroundCategory but depends on []. The preview stays stale after edits.
findings.suggestion: Add markdownContent and backgroundCategory to the dependency array.

findings.title: Render failures are silently swallowed
findings.description: The promise chain ends with .catch(() => {}), hiding renderHandoutHtml errors from users and observability.
findings.suggestion: Log or surface the error; set an error state or call Sentry.captureException.

findings.title: Service role key hardcoded in API route
findings.description: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is a literal in source and passed to createClient, bypassing user-scoped RLS and cookie auth.
findings.suggestion: Remove the literal; use the SSR anon key from astro:env/server and enforce gm_id from the authenticated user.

findings.title: Duplicate route has no authentication gate
findings.description: POST handler never calls supabase.auth.getUser() or returns 401 for anonymous callers.
findings.suggestion: Mirror other handout routes: resolve user, return 401 when absent.

findings.title: Client-supplied gmId trusted for insert
findings.description: insert uses body.gmId from unvalidated JSON, allowing duplication under another user's account when combined with service role.
findings.suggestion: Validate body with zod if needed; always set gm_id from authenticated user.id.

findings.title: 404 response exposes stack trace
findings.description: Error payload includes stack: new Error().stack, leaking internal paths to clients.
findings.suggestion: Return a generic not-found message without stack or internal details.

findings.title: API route missing prerender = false
findings.description: New duplicate.ts does not export const prerender = false, breaking Astro SSR API route convention.
findings.suggestion: Add export const prerender = false after imports.

findings.title: Dashboard layout change is out of scope
findings.description: Adding max-w-6xl to dashboard.astro is unrelated to preview migration or duplicate API.
findings.suggestion: Revert dashboard change or move to a separate PR.

findings.title: New table created without RLS
findings.description: handout_duplicates_log has no enable row level security or policies.
findings.suggestion: Enable RLS and add per-operation policies scoped to handout ownership.

findings.title: No tests for duplicate API or migration
findings.description: New API route and audit table ship without unit or integration coverage for auth, validation, or RLS.
findings.suggestion: Add integration tests for duplicate POST (401, 404, success) and migration RLS behavior.
